title: LIFX Wi-Fi Reconnect Flap
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifx:state event=wifi_reconnect
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as reconnects by bulb _time
| where reconnects>3
| sort - reconnects
description: Uses LIFX connectivity events telemetry to monitor how often bulbs are dropping and rejoining Wi-Fi in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for lighting devices that are unstable on the network, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest LIFX connectivity events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily bulb chart of reconnect counts.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often bulbs are dropping and rejoining Wi-Fi so you can spot lighting devices that are unstable on the network before it becomes annoying.
